$comment: schema_version 0.1.0; validates replay_result.yaml written by nova replay.
title: ReplayResult
description: Output manifest of a NovaFabric replay run. Written to .novafabric/replays/<replay-id>/replay_result.yaml.

replay_id.description: ULID uniquely identifying this replay run.

replay_of_run_id.description: run_id of the source capsule being replayed.

start_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the replay started.

end_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the replay finished.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the replay in milliseconds.

policy_flags_used.description: Safety ladder flags active during this replay.

env_warnings.description: Environment differences between recorded env.lock and current runtime.

model_calls_mocked.description: Number of model calls served from cache.

tool_calls_mocked.description: Number of tool responses served from cache. ADR-0261: this is currently always 0 -- the replay engine substitutes model responses only, and no tool dispatcher is installed on any path. See tool_calls_available for the count the capsule carried.

tool_calls_available.description: Tool calls the capsule carried into this replay and that a dispatcher could serve. Additive and optional (ADR-0261); not a claim that any were substituted.

exit_code.description: Exit code of the replayed command (mocked mode only).

error.description: Error details if status is failure or aborted.

schema_drift.description: Tool calls whose stored arguments/result no longer conform to their declared *_schema_ref (ADR-0128). Additive, optional; recorded in every mode, gating only in exact.
